verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms supabase.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and links to a full-documentation file. The docs describe per-language agent corpora, an explicit 'API and agent resources' section, Agent Skills that agents load on demand, and static prompt files for agents that lack MCP or skills support. Missing for 10: the docs.md probe returned 404, so markdown versions of docs pages are unproven, and there is no independent or community report of agents actually consuming llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: plus per-language reference corpora for agents (llms/js.txt, dart, swift, kotlin, python, csharp, server, cli, api) and the full-corpus llms-full.txt
Agent Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that agents can discover and use to do things more accurately and efficiently
We've curated a selection of prompts to help you work with Supabase using your favorite AI-powered IDE tools, such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot.
